classes.name: Statins
classes.description: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors: atorvastatin (Lipitor), rosuvastatin (Crestor, Ezallor), simvastatin (Zocor), pravastatin, lovastatin (Altoprev), pitavastatin (Livalo, Zypitamag), fluvastatin, and statin combinations (Vytorin, Roszet).
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill that lowers LDL cholesterol.

classes.name: Ezetimibe & other non-statin oral agents
classes.description: Non-statin oral LDL-lowering agents: ezetimibe (Zetia), bempedoic acid (Nexletol) and bempedoic acid/ezetimibe (Nexlizet).
classes.plainDescription: A cholesterol pill used with or instead of a statin.

classes.name: PCSK9 inhibitors & siRNA
classes.description: Injectable PCSK9-pathway agents: evolocumab (Repatha), alirocumab (Praluent), inclisiran (Leqvio).
classes.plainDescription: An injection every 2 weeks to 6 months that strongly lowers LDL cholesterol.
